description: The implementations manifest: the file a run of the conformance harness is given with --implementations, naming what the run holds to Protocol. Every service is run by the xynolog launcher, from the image the knowledge base's stack documents name (contract/LAUNCHER-CONTROL.md, service.run): an implementation is a knowledge base whose documents name its images, and another implementation is another manifest. Each SDK's drivers are programs the harness starts itself, since none is a service. There is no default manifest. The reader reads this schema in the table dialect, and the harness decodes every manifest by the model it gives.

launcher.description: How the launcher's control API is served: the xynolog command, run with control. A command and its arguments, as the harness starts it. An argument that starts with ./ or ../ is a path, resolved against the manifest's own directory; every other is passed as written.

target.description: The knowledge base whose stack documents name each service's image, and whose stack runs the record and index the suites need. A relative root is resolved against the manifest's own directory.

sdks.description: Each SDK's drivers, by the SDK's name: the programs the SDK and worker suites talk to in its place (conformance/sdk/README.md, "The driver protocol").

wire.description: How its wire driver is started. A command and its arguments, as the harness starts it. An argument that starts with ./ or ../ is a path, resolved against the manifest's own directory; every other is passed as written.

live.description: How its live driver is started, and the tier of the live corpus the SDK is held to.

command.description: How its live driver is started. A command and its arguments, as the harness starts it. An argument that starts with ./ or ../ is a path, resolved against the manifest's own directory; every other is passed as written.

worker.description: How its worker driver is started, when the SDK has a worker's surface (conformance/worker/README.md). A command and its arguments, as the harness starts it. An argument that starts with ./ or ../ is a path, resolved against the manifest's own directory; every other is passed as written.

exempt.description: The wire cases its driver cannot be put through, by the case's name, each with why. The suite holds an exemption as it holds a case: the driver must answer unsupported to what the case asks, or the exemption is stale.

modelCatalogue.description: The model catalogue the implementation supplies, by its path; a relative one is resolved against the manifest's own directory. The Librarian's and the worker service's documents name one, so a run of either suite without it refuses to start.
